_about: Openly licensed templates from other authors, offered under "From the community" in the new-project dialog. Each is pinned to a commit. After a change here, run `npm run templates` to refresh public/templates/. See README.md in this folder for what a template needs to be listed.

templates.name: Jake's Resume
templates.description: A clean one-page resume, popular for software jobs
templates.author: Jake Gutierrez

templates.name: Academic CV
templates.description: Education, publications, talks and teaching, with comments that explain each part
templates.author: Sara Venkatraman

templates.name: One-page Resume
templates.description: A compact resume with education, experience and skills
templates.author: Sara Venkatraman

templates.name: Expressive Resume
templates.description: A colourful resume with icons, and a matching cover letter
templates.author: Joseph Hale

templates.name: arXiv Preprint
templates.description: A paper in the style of a conference preprint, with ORCID links
templates.author: George Kour

templates.name: Research Paper
templates.description: A paper split into section files, with handy maths commands
templates.author: Sara Venkatraman

templates.name: Lecture Notes
templates.description: Course notes with one file per lecture, theorem boxes and figures
templates.author: Sara Venkatraman

templates.name: Homework
templates.description: Problem sets with numbered problems, solutions and code
templates.author: Sara Venkatraman

templates.name: Essay
templates.description: A plain essay with a title block and footnotes
templates.author: Sara Venkatraman

templates.name: Tufte Handout
templates.description: Wide margins for side notes and small figures, after Edward Tufte's books
templates.author: The Tufte-LaTeX developers

templates.name: Metropolis Slides
templates.description: The popular flat, modern beamer theme with its demo talk, set in the standard font because its Fira font needs XeLaTeX
